mapper.sql: id, role, name, birth_date, phone_number, email, password, profile_image_key, status
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MBR_INFO_M SET profile_image_key = #{profileImageKey}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS child_id, c.name, c.email, c.profile_image_key, c.teeny_score, COALESCE(w.balance, 0) AS balance FROM T_MBR_CONN_R conn JOIN T_MBR_INFO_M c ON c.id = conn.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN T_WLT_BASE_M w ON w.member_id = c.id AND w.type = 'MEMBER' WHERE conn.parent_id = #{parentId} AND conn.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY conn.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MBR_AGRMT_H ( member_id, agreement_id, status, actor_type, actor_member_id, verification_method, verification_reference ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{agreementId}, #{status}, #{actorType}, #{actorMemberId}, #{verificationMethod}, #{verificationReference} )

INSERT INTO T_MBR_LEGAL_GUARDIAN_M ( child_member_id, name, phone_number, relationship, verification_method, verification_reference, verified_at ) VALUES ( #{childMemberId}, #{name}, #{phoneNumber}, #{relationship}, #{verificationMethod}, #{verificationReference}, #{verifiedAt} )

INSERT INTO T_MBR_CONN_R ( parent_id, child_id, status ) SELECT parent_member.id, child_member.id, 'ACTIVE' FROM T_MBR_INFO_M parent_member JOIN T_MBR_INFO_M child_member ON child_member.id = #{childId} WHERE parent_member.id = #{parentId} AND parent_member.role = 'PARENT' AND parent_member.status = 'ACTIVE' AND child_member.role = 'CHILD' AND child_member.status = 'ACTIVE'
